description: This file defines React components for a UI sheet/modal, utilizing Radix UI primitives and custom styling. It includes components like Sheet, SheetTrigger, SheetClose, SheetContent, and others, with forwarding refs and styling logic.

methods.name: Sheet
methods.description: Main sheet component wrapping Radix UI Root primitive.

methods.name: SheetTrigger
methods.description: Component for triggering the sheet, forwards ref to Radix Trigger.

methods.name: SheetClose
methods.description: Component for closing the sheet, forwards ref to Radix Close.

methods.name: SheetOverlay
methods.description: Overlay component with styling and animation for the sheet background.

methods.name: SheetContent
methods.description: Main content container for the sheet, manages overlay and portal.

methods.name: SheetHeader
methods.description: Header section of the sheet, optionally includes a close button.

methods.name: SheetFooter
methods.description: Footer section for actions or buttons.
